title: Fig Tidies Up
checkpoint: Reception Autumn 2, week 3 — Learning — Phase 3: new sounds l, ll, ss

pages.illustration: Fig the green caterpillar standing on a mossy log beside a compost heap.
A scattered mess of plain clay pots and tin cups tipped over on and around the log, Fig looking at it.

pages.text: Pots and cups sit on it.
pages.illustration: Several plain clay pots and tin cups lying across the top of the log in a jumble.

pages.text: Fig tips a pot. Fig taps a cup.
pages.illustration: Fig the caterpillar nudging a clay pot upright with his head, a tin cup beside him.

pages.text: Fig pops a pot in a bag.
pages.illustration: Fig the caterpillar pushing a small clay pot into the top of an open cloth bag.

pages.text: Fig pops a cup in a bag.
pages.illustration: Fig the caterpillar pushing a tin cup into the same open cloth bag.

pages.text: The mess is off the log.
pages.illustration: The log now bare and clear, the full cloth bag sitting beside it on the ground.
Fig the caterpillar sitting happily on the now-tidy log, the compost heap neat behind him.
